reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in our direct message and confirmed I have the new 7 July cutoff for the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork. I told them I'll keep it private and won't mention it in channels or in anyone else's conversations.

I didn't save it to GBrain or anywhere else. Other people can read GBrain, so saving it there would break their request to keep it between us. Their message in our DM is the only record.

GBrain had nothing that conflicts with the new date. Its search wasn't running at full strength, so it may have missed related notes. No other action was needed.
